answer: Proof of stake acts as a falcon patrolling the network, ensuring each identity requires capital collateral to participate. An attacker attempting to flood the lagoon of nodes with fake agents faces a jetty of economic barriers, as they must deploy significant financial assets to gain voting power. This mechanism forces the adversary to bear the full cost of network dilution, rendering the creation of numerous Sybil identities prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
